g.text: 1. Columns are sequence waves: an activity can start when every activity it needs (solid arrows) has issued.
2. Dashed arrows are iteration loops: a later result revises an earlier activity.
3. Box style: solid = issued (FEED); double = issued, provisional; dashed grey = not started.
4. Generated from cfu/wrapup/activities.py and checked against data/dataflow.json (build trace).
5. See CFU-000-PM-DEP-001 for inputs, impacts and the change-impact matrix.
